run_rl_agent_evaluation: run a trained SAC or TD3 RL agent on a PyBullet environment for N episodes
load_trained_model: load a saved SAC or TD3 model from a zip file for evaluation
render_pybullet_environment: render a PyBullet Gym environment in human GUI mode during evaluation
evaluate_episode_rewards: evaluate deterministic episode rewards and lengths across multiple episodes
compute_results_statistics: compute mean and standard deviation of episode rewards and lengths
